title: Whirlpool
description: Draw a spiral: pink (1.0, 0.45, 0.7) and plum (0.2, 0.05, 0.3) arms winding out from the center. Take v = length(uv) * 3.0 - atan(uv.y, uv.x) / 6.2831853, then switch bands where abs(fract(v) - 0.5) crosses 0.25, with a smoothstep from 0.24 to 0.26. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 in both directions.
hintText: A spiral is rings whose radius depends on the angle. Start from fract(length(uv) * 3.0), then subtract atan(uv.y, uv.x) / 6.2831853 so every full turn shifts the pattern by one ring.
